mentions.name: Estonian Startup Jobs
mentions.description: A super simple local startup job board for Estonia, deliberately kept free of calls, AI chat bots, and fancy matching. Maintained with 1-2 hours of work per week.
mentions.problem: Existing job boards add noise like calls, AI chat bots, and fancy matching; the author wanted a straightforward local startup job board for their country.
